metadata.title: G36 VAV Reheat Block UI Component

story.iWant: to see the G36 VAV Reheat block on the canvas with I/O connectors
story.soThat: I can wire it to BACnet points

tasks.task: Create Control Sequences sidebar section Create control-sequences-section.tsx following logic-nodes-section.tsx pattern Add G36 VAV Reheat as draggable item with distinct icon Configure drag data: type: 'control-sequence-node', nodeType: 'g36-vav-reheat' Add section to supervisors tab or create new tab in sidebar

Add addControlSequenceNode to flow store Add addControlSequenceNode action to flow-slice.ts Generate UUID client-side for instance_id Call POST /api/v1/g36/vav-reheat/instances with instance_id On success: create React Flow node with instanceId in metadata On failure: show error toast, don't add node
Update drag-and-drop handler Add control-sequence-node case to use-node-creation.ts Call new addControlSequenceNode action

Add node deletion API call Hook into node deletion in flow store For control-sequence nodes, call DELETE /api/v1/g36/vav-reheat/instances/{instance_id} Fire-and-forget: don't block deletion on API response
Add API client functions to control-sequence domain Create api/client.ts with createInstance and deleteInstance functions Use generated client from api/generated/sdk.gen.ts Export from domain index

Write component tests Test G36VavReheatNode renders with correct structure Test input handles render with labels Test output handles render with labels Test add/remove handle interactions Test ControlSequencesSection renders in sidebar Test drag data format is correct

Write integration tests for API lifecycle Test addControlSequenceNode calls API and creates node on success Test addControlSequenceNode handles API error gracefully Test node deletion calls DELETE API

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: G36 VAV Reheat block renders on canvas with distinct visual style
Input connectors visible and labeled (zoneTemperature, coolingSetpoint, etc.)
Output connectors visible and labeled (damperPosition, valvePosition, airflowSetpoint)
Block appears in palette under "Control Sequences" category
Drag-drop creates API instance via POST /api/v1/g36/vav-reheat/instances
Node stores returned instance_id in node data

constraints.constraint: TDD: Write tests first, then implement
Follow existing sidebar section pattern from logic-nodes-section.tsx
Follow existing flow store action pattern from addLogicNode
API is source of truth for parameters - Designer only stores instance_id
Use generated API client functions, don't make raw fetch calls
Fire-and-forget for DELETE - don't block UI on API response
instance_id must be globally unique UUID - use crypto.randomUUID()
Don't add comments unless explaining WHY something was done
Use shadcn/ui components (Button, Card, Badge, etc.)

interface.signature: { type: 'control-sequence-node', nodeType: 'g36-vav-reheat', label: string, metadata?: Record, draggedFrom: 'control-sequences-section' }

interface.signature: (nodeType: NodeTypeString, label: string, position: XYPosition, metadata?: Record) => Promise

tests.standards: Use Jest + React Testing Library for component tests. Mock API calls using jest.mock() for the generated SDK functions. Test user interactions (drag, drop, delete). Verify React Flow node structure. Follow TDD - write failing tests first.
